title: Crawler will not read the sitemap URL
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

\*I could not find a repo for the crawler. Please direct me to that team as needed.

When I run the crawler will not read the sitemap.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Create a crawler with `https://www.eftours.com/` as the starting point.
2. Remove the startUrls param (we need the sitemap because it has more urls on it)
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/067a6734-496d-416c-bacf-089781a035b3)
3. Using the default setup run the crawler. It will not find any urls.

### Live reproduction

NA

### 💭 Expected behavior

The sitemap should be read.

I used <https://github.com/algolia/404-crawler> to see if the sitemap had an issue. No issues on the sitemap were found. It was able to read the file and find all the urls correctly.

I also tried to contact support but haven't heard back in over a week <https://support.algolia.com/hc/en-us/requests/645792?page=1>

### Package version

Algolia Crawler
